observed_scope_summary: Desktop and mobile captures retain distinct materials, question, response and follow-up regions. At the shown 320px and 844x390 conditions, key input and follow-up actions remain visible without a demonstrated horizontal overflow.

Chinese and the supplemental English content are visibly rendered. The long answer continues behind a bounded reading region above the fixed composer; full-resolution lower-reading evidence shows the table, attachments and follow-up options above it.

The materials drawer and import/edit dialogs provide visibly available close/completion controls in the recorded states. Partial import success is separate from file-specific failures; the storage warning retains visible input and recovery controls.
Example limitations are stated in the answer, badges and composer areas. The English response explicitly says it is a fixed example and not an analysis of the entered question or local files.

The contact sheet was used only to identify ordered visual states. Its 04 and 09 states were separately opened as full-resolution images; contact-sheet miniatures were not used as typography, smoothness or frame-delivery proof.
limits: Static images establish the visible states only. No keyboard/touch/focus, actual scrolling, modal dismissal, file import, local storage, export or copy behavior was executed in this review.
No video was played and no dense continuous sequence was inspected. Contact-sheet order/timestamps do not establish motion smoothness, absence of flicker or actual frame delivery.
The settled modal image and import-stable-manual-review image have the same SHA256. Both requested files were opened but they represent one distinct captured pixel result.
Only an English content response was inspected; this is not a claim that the entire interface is localized into English.
Browser, DPR, zoom, font readiness and capture timing were not independently measured. Numerical contrast, accessible names and hidden/control states require separate engineering evidence.
Screenshot quality does not establish actual adoption of mature implementation or source provenance; those require implementation and research/trial evidence.

viewed_files.scope: Baseline desktop composition, discussion/note balance, type hierarchy and visible controls.
Baseline narrow note, title wrapping, edit toolbar, footer and bottom navigation.
Edit state: discussion, note, formatting tools, outline and content hierarchy.
Read state: removed edit toolbar, note hierarchy, outline and edit return.
Source context in left region, current citation, note retained at right and source actions.
Long Chinese content, current heading, readable type/line spacing, progress and bottom navigation.
Expanded editing tools, visible controls, reduced content viewport and current heading.
Outline dialog hierarchy, active section, nested headings, close control and bounded content.

320px wrapping, toolbar fit, title/body readability and bottom navigation.
480px-tall discussion viewport, composer/send visibility, toast overlap and bottom navigation.
Visible save failure, backup action, unsaved state, retained edited title, body and navigation.
Ordered state 1: note at 48% with visible text anchor and citation 3.
Ordered state 2: source title, contextual paragraph 3, current-citation highlight and return affordances.
Ordered state 3: source content at another scroll position, stable source actions and return affordances.
Ordered state 4: return to the same visible note anchor and 48% progress as state 1.

summary.conclusion: No blocking visual defect found within the inspected states and image identities.

findings.observation: The revised desktop arrangement gives the note a distinct central reading region and a clearly separated outline. The title, section headings, body, citations and secondary labels remain distinguishable. Read mode removes the editing toolbar while keeping an evident Edit action and the persistent discussion context.
findings.boundary: This supports these static compositions; it does not establish keyboard behavior, focus handling, transition rhythm or user preference.

findings.observation: Source views visibly distinguish the source title, surrounding paragraphs and the currently cited paragraph. Citation and discussion actions plus return affordances remain visible in the provided source states. The desktop note remains present alongside its source context.
findings.boundary: Only the displayed scroll positions were inspected; source-end reachability and operation results require interaction evidence.

findings.observation: Chinese glyphs render clearly. Long content has discernible line and paragraph rhythm; title/body wrapping stays inside the inspected 320px and 390px widths. Reading/editing tools and bottom navigation remain visibly distinct. Expanding formatting tools reduces the available reading area without covering the displayed heading.
findings.boundary: The larger reading-size state is a supported presentation choice, not evidence of a universally superior density. A screenshot cannot establish all tools operable or keyboard-safe.

findings.observation: The outline and reading-settings overlays fit the depicted mobile viewport, maintain clear titles, and expose close controls. Outline hierarchy and the selected heading are visible. Reading settings show three differentiated choices, the selected larger size, a readable preview and an unobstructed completion action.
findings.boundary: Modal scrolling, trapping/restoring focus, touch target dimensions and other heights were not operated by this reviewer.

findings.observation: A differentiated warning banner, visible backup action and unsaved label accompany the retained edited Chinese title. The warning fits above the toolbar without hiding its controls; the note and navigation remain visible.
findings.boundary: The visible state supports truthful communication in the image, not a storage failure/recovery or backup correctness test.

findings.observation: The ordered images show note -> source context -> another source position -> note. States 1 and 4 have the same first visible text, citation 3 placement and 48% progress, supporting restoration of that visible reading position in this recorded journey.
findings.boundary: There are no inspected intermediate frames or timing information. These images do not establish animation smoothness, absence of flicker, exact response time, DOM focus or every return path.

findings.observation: At 390x480, the toast occupies the middle conversation area and covers part of the assistant role line. The composer, send control and bottom navigation remain visible and the active input text is readable.
findings.impact: Temporary reduction of visible conversation context in this captured short-height state; no core action is visibly blocked.
findings.boundary: Toast duration, motion and dismissal were not observed, so persistence or timing cannot be assessed.

limits: This inspection is based on original PNG pixels and ordered captured states only; no live application operations, video replay or continuous-motion analysis were performed.
Readability and visible control placement were assessed in the provided images. Keyboard, touch, focus, screen-reader, persistence, backup and source-data correctness remain separate runtime checks.

Screenshots alone do not establish that selected mature resources are actually retained in code or that all four observation objects were inspected. Actual adoption and trial provenance require the application source and research records.
Images were inspected at their recorded pixel dimensions. Browser, DPR, font readiness, zoom and capture timestamps were not independently measured by this reviewer.
The review covers the 16 requested files. Other captures, viewports, themes, states and future source revisions are outside its conclusion.
